refnamediv.refpurpose: Returns a scalar value to be used as a hash value

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
public mixedDs\Key::hash
Returns a scalar value to be used as the hash value of the object.
While the hash value does not define equality, all objects that are equal according to Ds\Key::equals must have the same hash value. Hash values of equal objects do not have to be unique: returning &true; for every object would not break anything, the only implication being that the hash table degenerates into a linked list, because every object hashes to the same bucket. Picking a good hash value, such as an ID or an email address, is therefore important.
This method allows objects to be used as keys in structures such as Ds\Map and Ds\Set, or any other lookup structure that honors this interface.
Do not pick a value that might change within the object, such as a public property. Hash table lookups would fail because the hash has changed.

&reftitle.returnvalues;
A scalar value to be used as this object's hash value.
